## Interactive County Yield Map

Use the **crop** and **year** controls to inspect county-level yields. Counties with no reported observation for the selected combination are shown in gray; gray is not a zero yield.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import html

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, display
import plotly

ROOT = Path.cwd()
csv_path = ROOT / "data" / "processed" / "USDA_Crop_Yields_Cleaned.csv"
geo_path = ROOT / "data" / "geographic" / "counties_5digit.geojson"

if not csv_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required cleaned USDA data was not found: {csv_path}")
if not geo_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Required county boundary GeoJSON was not found: {geo_path}")

raw = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
states = ["IOWA", "ILLINOIS"]
crops = ["CORN", "SOYBEANS"]
years = list(range(2015, 2026))

required = {"STATE_NAME", "STATE_ANSI", "COUNTY_ANSI", "COUNTY_NAME", "YEAR", "COMMODITY_DESC", "YIELD"}
missing = required.difference(raw.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Cleaned USDA data is missing required columns: {sorted(missing)}")

data = raw.copy()
data["STATE_NAME"] = data["STATE_NAME"].astype(str).str.upper().str.strip()
data["COMMODITY_DESC"] = data["COMMODITY_DESC"].astype(str).str.upper().str.strip()
data["YEAR"] = pd.to_numeric(data["YEAR"], errors="coerce")
data["YIELD"] = pd.to_numeric(data["YIELD"], errors="coerce")
data["STATE_ANSI"] = data["STATE_ANSI"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(2)
data["COUNTY_ANSI"] = data["COUNTY_ANSI"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\.0$", "", regex=True).str.zfill(3)
data = data[
    data["STATE_NAME"].isin(states)
    & data["COMMODITY_DESC"].isin(crops)
    & data["YEAR"].isin(years)
    & data["YIELD"].notna()
    & ~data["COUNTY_NAME"].astype(str).str.contains("OTHER|COMBINED", case=False, na=False)
].copy()
data["FIPS"] = data["STATE_ANSI"] + data["COUNTY_ANSI"]
if data.empty:
    raise ValueError("No Iowa/Illinois corn/soybean yield observations are available for 2015–2025.")
if data.duplicated(["STATE_NAME", "COUNTY_ANSI", "COMMODITY_DESC", "YEAR"]).any():
    raise ValueError("Duplicate county-year-crop records detected in the cleaned USDA data.")

geo = json.loads(geo_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
geo["features"] = [
    feature for feature in geo.get("features", [])
    if str(feature.get("id", feature.get("properties", {}).get("GEOID", ""))).zfill(5)[:2] in {"17", "19"}
]
for feature in geo["features"]:
    props = feature.setdefault("properties", {})
    props["GEOID"] = str(feature.get("id", props.get("GEOID", ""))).zfill(5)
    props["NAME"] = props.get("NAME", "County")

records = data[["STATE_NAME", "COUNTY_NAME", "COUNTY_ANSI", "FIPS", "YEAR", "COMMODITY_DESC", "YIELD"]].copy()
records["YIELD"] = records["YIELD"].round(3)
payload = {
    "states": states,
    "crops": crops,
    "years": years,
    "records": records.to_dict(orient="records"),
    "geojson": geo,
    "ranges": {
        crop: [float(data.loc[data["COMMODITY_DESC"] == crop, "YIELD"].min()), float(data.loc[data["COMMODITY_DESC"] == crop, "YIELD"].max())]
        for crop in crops
    },
}

payload_json = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).replace("</", "<\\/")
plotly_js = plotly.offline.get_plotlyjs()

page = r'''<style>
.yield-shell { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #18324b; }
.yield-controls { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap: .8rem 1.2rem; align-items:center; margin: .2rem 0 .5rem; font-size: .82rem; }
.yield-controls label { font-weight: 650; }
.yield-controls select, .yield-controls button { border: 1px solid #b7c7d6; border-radius: .35rem; padding: .35rem .55rem; background: white; color:#18324b; }
.yield-controls select[multiple] { min-width: 260px; height: 105px; }
.yield-controls button { cursor:pointer; background:#edf4f8; }
.yield-chart { width:100%; height: 650px; }
.explorer-chart { height: 610px; }
.yield-note { font-size:.72rem; color:#526879; margin:.15rem 0; }
.error-box { color:#8a1c1c; background:#fff1f1; border:1px solid #e1a4a4; padding:1rem; border-radius:.4rem; }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .yield-chart { height: 560px; } .explorer-chart { height: 520px; } }
</style>
<div class="yield-shell" id="yield-presentation"></div>
<script>window.__USDA_YIELD_PAYLOAD__ = ''' + payload_json + r''';</script>
<script>
/* The Plotly library is embedded below by the Quarto Python cell. */
</script>
<script>''' + plotly_js + r'''</script>
<script>
(function () {
  const P = window.__USDA_YIELD_PAYLOAD__;
  const root = document.getElementById("yield-presentation");
  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]));
  const rows = P.records;
  const byKey = (state, crop, year) => rows.filter(r => r.STATE_NAME === state && r.COMMODITY_DESC === crop && Number(r.YEAR) === Number(year));
  const countyFeatures = P.geojson.features;
  const geoids = countyFeatures.map(f => String(f.properties.GEOID));
  const cropLabel = c => c === "CORN" ? "Corn" : "Soybeans";

  root.innerHTML = `
    <section>
      <div class="yield-controls">
        <label>Crop <select id="map-crop">${P.crops.map(c => `<option value="${c}">${cropLabel(c)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>
        <label>Year <select id="map-year">${P.years.map(y => `<option>${y}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>
      </div>
      <div class="yield-note">Color scales are fixed within each crop across years. Gray counties have no reported yield.</div>
      <div id="yield-map" class="yield-chart"></div>
    </section>
    <section>
      <div class="yield-controls">
        <label>State <select id="line-state">${P.states.map(s => `<option value="${s}">${s[0] + s.slice(1).toLowerCase()}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>
        <label>Crop <select id="line-crop">${P.crops.map(c => `<option value="${c}">${cropLabel(c)}</option>`).join("")}</select></label>
        <label>Counties<br><select id="line-counties" multiple></select></label>
        <button id="select-all" type="button">Select all</button><button id="clear-all" type="button">Clear</button>
        <label><input id="show-average" type="checkbox" checked> State average</label>
      </div>
      <div class="yield-note">Use Ctrl/Cmd-click to select multiple counties. Missing years remain gaps.</div>
      <div id="yield-explorer" class="yield-chart explorer-chart"></div>
    </section>`;

  const mapEl = document.getElementById("yield-map");
  function mapTrace(crop, year) {
    const vals = Object.fromEntries(byKey("IOWA", crop, year).concat(byKey("ILLINOIS", crop, year)).map(r => [r.FIPS, r]));
    const observed = geoids.filter(id => vals[id]);
    const missing = geoids.filter(id => !vals[id]);
    const observedRows = observed.map(id => vals[id]);
    return [
      { type:"choropleth", geojson:P.geojson, locations:observed, z:observedRows.map(r => r.YIELD), featureidkey:"properties.GEOID", zmin:P.ranges[crop][0], zmax:P.ranges[crop][1], colorscale:"YlGn", marker:{line:{color:"white",width:.45}}, customdata:observedRows.map(r => [r.STATE_NAME, r.COUNTY_NAME, r.YEAR, cropLabel(r.COMMODITY_DESC), r.YIELD]), hovertemplate:"<b>%{customdata[1]} County</b><br>State: %{customdata[0]}<br>Year: %{customdata[2]}<br>Crop: %{customdata[3]}<br>Yield: %{customdata[4]:.1f} BU/ACRE<extra></extra>", colorbar:{title:"BU/ACRE"}, showscale:true },
      { type:"choropleth", geojson:P.geojson, locations:missing, z:missing.map(() => 0), featureidkey:"properties.GEOID", colorscale:[[0,"#d9dee3"],[1,"#d9dee3"]], showscale:false, marker:{line:{color:"white",width:.45}}, customdata:missing.map(id => { const f=countyFeatures.find(x=>String(x.properties.GEOID)===id); return [f.properties.NAME, id.slice(0,2)==="19"?"IOWA":"ILLINOIS", year, cropLabel(crop)]; }), hovertemplate:"<b>%{customdata[0]} County</b><br>State: %{customdata[1]}<br>Year: %{customdata[2]}<br>Crop: %{customdata[3]}<br>Yield: No data<extra></extra>" }
    ];
  }
  function renderMap() {
    const crop=document.getElementById("map-crop").value, year=Number(document.getElementById("map-year").value);
    Plotly.react(mapEl, mapTrace(crop, year), {title:`${cropLabel(crop)} Yields by County (${year})`, geo:{fitbounds:"locations",visible:false}, margin:{l:0,r:0,t:55,b:0}, paper_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)", font:{family:"system-ui"}}, {responsive:true,displaylogo:false});
  }
  document.getElementById("map-crop").addEventListener("change",renderMap); document.getElementById("map-year").addEventListener("change",renderMap); renderMap();

  const stateEl=document.getElementById("line-state"), cropEl=document.getElementById("line-crop"), countyEl=document.getElementById("line-counties"), avgEl=document.getElementById("show-average"), lineEl=document.getElementById("yield-explorer");
  function updateCountyOptions() {
    const subset=rows.filter(r=>r.STATE_NAME===stateEl.value && r.COMMODITY_DESC===cropEl.value);
    const counties=[...new Map(subset.map(r=>[r.COUNTY_ANSI,r.COUNTY_NAME])).entries()].sort((a,b)=>a[1].localeCompare(b[1]));
    countyEl.innerHTML=counties.map(([id,name])=>`<option value="${id}">${esc(name)}</option>`).join("");
    counties.slice(0,5).forEach(([id])=>countyEl.querySelector(`option[value="${id}"]`).selected=true);
    renderLines();
  }
  function renderLines() {
    const state=stateEl.value,crop=cropEl.value, selected=[...countyEl.selectedOptions].map(o=>o.value), subset=rows.filter(r=>r.STATE_NAME===state&&r.COMMODITY_DESC===crop);
    const traces=selected.map(id=>{ const cr=subset.filter(r=>r.COUNTY_ANSI===id).sort((a,b)=>a.YEAR-b.YEAR); return {type:"scatter",mode:"lines+markers",name:cr[0]?.COUNTY_NAME||id,x:cr.map(r=>r.YEAR),y:cr.map(r=>r.YIELD),connectgaps:false,hovertemplate:`<b>${esc(cr[0]?.COUNTY_NAME||id)} County</b><br>Year: %{x}<br>Yield: %{y:.1f} BU/ACRE<extra></extra>`}; });
    if(avgEl.checked){ const avg=P.years.map(year=>{const v=subset.filter(r=>Number(r.YEAR)===year).map(r=>r.YIELD); return v.length?v.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/v.length:null;}); traces.push({type:"scatter",mode:"lines+markers",name:"Average County Yield",x:P.years,y:avg,connectgaps:false,line:{color:"#17202a",width:3,dash:"dash"},hovertemplate:"<b>Average County Yield</b><br>Year: %{x}<br>Yield: %{y:.1f} BU/ACRE<extra></extra>"});}
    Plotly.react(lineEl,traces,{title:`${state[0]+state.slice(1).toLowerCase()} ${cropLabel(crop)} Yields by County`,xaxis:{title:"Year",tickmode:"linear",dtick:1},yaxis:{title:"Yield (Bushels per Acre)"},hovermode:"closest",template:"plotly_white",margin:{l:65,r:20,t:55,b:55},legend:{orientation:"h",y:-.18}}, {responsive:true,displaylogo:false});
  }
  stateEl.addEventListener("change",updateCountyOptions); cropEl.addEventListener("change",updateCountyOptions); countyEl.addEventListener("change",renderLines); avgEl.addEventListener("change",renderLines);
  document.getElementById("select-all").addEventListener("click",()=>{[...countyEl.options].forEach(o=>o.selected=true);renderLines();}); document.getElementById("clear-all").addEventListener("click",()=>{[...countyEl.options].forEach(o=>o.selected=false);renderLines();});
  updateCountyOptions();
  /* Keep the map and explorer on separate Reveal slides while retaining one
     shared browser-side data payload and Plotly runtime. */
  const slide = root.closest("section");
  const panels = root.querySelectorAll(":scope > section");
  if (slide && panels.length > 1) {
    const explorerSlide = document.createElement("section");
    const heading = document.createElement("h2");
    heading.textContent = "Interactive County Yield Explorer";
    explorerSlide.appendChild(heading);
    explorerSlide.appendChild(panels[1]);
    slide.parentElement.insertBefore(explorerSlide, slide.nextSibling);
    if (window.Reveal) window.setTimeout(() => window.Reveal.sync(), 0);
  }
})();
</script>'''

print(page)
```

## Data Notes and Limitations

- **Source:** USDA NASS Quick Stats, using the notebook’s cached/cleaned county-yield workflow.
- County-level yields are aggregated estimates, not individual farm yields.
- Missing county observations can affect comparisons across years.
- The optional state-average line is an unweighted average of reporting counties, not an official statewide yield.
- This presentation supports only corn grain and soybeans, measured in bushels per acre, for Iowa and Illinois from 2015–2025.

The exported presentation contains the filtered observations and county boundaries needed by the two charts; it makes no USDA API requests and does not expose `.env` contents or the API key.
